dragonball_super_trailer_2026.headline: Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover

highlights: Final chapter (106) scheduled for Weekly Shounen Champion issue 2026 No.46 on October 15
The final chapter will span two printed chapters
12th and final tankōbon volume set for release on December 8, 2026
Titan Manga will release the English translation starting September 2027
dragonball_super_trailer_2026.why_it_matters: The series wraps up after a two‑year run, giving fans a definitive end and setting up its upcoming English launch.

fantastic_s_sue_storm_doctor_doom_reunit.headline: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom DLC
fantastic_s_sue_storm_doctor_doom_reunit.summary: Tribute Games announced a new Marvel Cosmic Invasion DLC adding Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom as playable characters.
highlights: The DLC, titled The Siege of Castle Doom, expands the roster from 15 to 17 heroes
Sue Storm joins as The Invisible Woman with force‑field abilities
Doctor Doom appears with his armor, tech and occult powers
A new Doom‑centered game mode is introduced, set in his headquarters
fantastic_s_sue_storm_doctor_doom_reunit.why_it_matters: The expansion brings two iconic Fantastic Four characters into the game just before the release of Avengers: Doomsday.

nycc_marvel_announces_brick_and_renown_c.headline: Marvel Bricks and Renown Collected Edition Lines
nycc_marvel_announces_brick_and_renown_c.summary: Marvel announced two new lines of collected editions, the paperback Marvel Bricks compendiums and the evergreen Marvel Renown series, at NYCC 2026.
highlights: Marvel Bricks will debut with four titles: Uncanny X‑Men: All New, All Different, Superior Spider‑Man: Hero or Menace?, Uncanny X‑Force: The Apocalypse
The Bricks will use newsprint‑like paper and feature a volume‑number indicator on the cover
Marvel Renown will keep back‑list titles in print indefinitely, starting with Punisher: Suicide Run, Daredevil: The Devil in Cell‑Block D, and All‑New Hawkeye
Both lines were revealed during NYCC Retailer Day by Marvel’s new Editor‑in‑Chief Stephen Wacker
nycc_marvel_announces_brick_and_renown_c.why_it_matters: The new formats aim to broaden Marvel’s trade‑paper market and ensure key stories stay continuously available for fans and retailers.

nycc_a_new_adventure_time_fionna_and_cak.headline: Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake (Oni Press)
nycc_a_new_adventure_time_fionna_and_cak.summary: Oni Press announced a new Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake comic series slated for release in January 2027.
highlights: The series is written by Jenna Ayoub and illustrated by Damali Beatty.
Announced at New York Comic Con Retailer Day in Manhattan.
It continues the spin‑off that expanded Fionna and Cake beyond the original show.
nycc_a_new_adventure_time_fionna_and_cak.why_it_matters: The new series revives popular characters for fans and expands the Adventure Time universe in print.

apothecary_diaries_film_crunchyroll_2026.headline: Bless (TV Anime)
apothecary_diaries_film_crunchyroll_2026.summary: The upcoming Bless TV anime announced that Yoshiki Nakajima will voice the character Joe Osaki.
highlights: Yoshiki Nakajima joins the cast as Joe Osaki
The series will debut in January 2027 on Fuji TV’s Noitamina block
Directed by Shōtarō Kitamura at A-1 Pictures with a full staff list released
apothecary_diaries_film_crunchyroll_2026.why_it_matters: Adding a notable voice actor expands the series' appeal and confirms key production details ahead of its 2027 launch.

bane_deathstroke_movie_title.headline: Savage Hunters
bane_deathstroke_movie_title.summary: The upcoming DC Studios Bane & Deathstroke team‑up film has been given the internal working title “Savage Hunters.”
highlights: The title “Savage Hunters” was revealed in a Deadline report and is being used internally at Warner Bros. and DC Studios
Matthew Orton was reported to be developing the script as of September 2024
Greg Mottola is the frontrunner to direct, having already helmed episodes of Peacemaker Season 2
The project is listed among early‑development DCU films and has not yet been greenlit, with its fate tied to the performance of the upcoming Clayface movie
bane_deathstroke_movie_title.why_it_matters: The film signals DC Studios’ continued focus on expanding the DCU with villain‑centric stories, potentially shaping the franchise’s direction beyond Batman.

additional_marronnier_oukoku_no_shichini.headline: Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi
additional_marronnier_oukoku_no_shichini.summary: The TV anime adaptation announced additional main cast members ahead of its October 3 premiere on NHK E‑Tele.
highlights: Natsuki Hanae, Mitsuki Saiga, and Miyuri Shimabukuro were added as Justice, Zoe, and Colette respectively
The series is directed by Kiyoko Sayama and produced by J.C.Staff
Series composition and script are handled by Shinzou Fujida, with character designs by Yuriko Maeda and music by Yoshiaki Fujisawa
The anime premiered on October 3, 2026 at 6:25 p.m. on NHK E‑Tele
additional_marronnier_oukoku_no_shichini.why_it_matters: Newly revealed cast members give fans insight into the voice talent shaping the adaptation’s core characters.

remarried_empress_anime_2027.headline: The Remarried Empress
remarried_empress_anime_2027.summary: A TV anime adaptation of the webtoon The Remarried Empress was announced for a 2027 premiere.
highlights: Announced at the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026
Director Tetsuya Yanagisawa and studio TROYCA attached to the project
Main cast includes Youko Hikasa, Ryouhei Kimura, Tomoaki Maeno, and Reina Ueda
Series set to debut in 2027
remarried_empress_anime_2027.why_it_matters: The adaptation brings a hugely popular webtoon with billions of views to the anime medium, expanding its global audience.

ghost_tsushima_legends_anime_announces_a.headline: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime
ghost_tsushima_legends_anime_announces_a.summary: The Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime, slated for a 2027 Crunchyroll debut, has announced two cast members, additional staff, and a delay to 2028.
highlights: Director Takanobu Mizuno is confirmed at Kamikaze Douga
Script by Satoshi Maejima and Gen Urobuchi with character design by Takashi Okazaki
Music composer Keiji Inai and sound director Yoshikazu Iwanami added to staff
Crunchyroll exclusive release pushed from 2027 to 2028
ghost_tsushima_legends_anime_announces_a.why_it_matters: The delay impacts fans awaiting the adaptation of the popular game’s multiplayer mode and highlights a high-profile creative team.

the_boxer_tv_anime_koki_uchiyama_kensho_.headline: The Boxer
the_boxer_tv_anime_koki_uchiyama_kensho_.summary: JH’s WEBTOON series The Boxer is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, revealed with a special trailer at the Crunchyroll Showcase.
highlights: Koki Uchiyama, Kensho Ono, Tomokazu Seki and Toshiyuki Toyonaga were announced as the main cast
Directors Yudai Kubota and KANG Wonyeong will helm the series
Animation is being produced by breccia in partnership with South Korea’s STUDIO JEMI
The project is part of a new partnership between HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier and Crunchyroll to adapt around 15 WEBTOON titles
the_boxer_tv_anime_koki_uchiyama_kensho_.why_it_matters: The adaptation brings a billion‑view webtoon to a global TV audience, showcasing a new cross‑border studio collaboration.

marvel_confirms_three_sequels_its_most_u.headline: Marvel Zombies
marvel_confirms_three_sequels_its_most_u.summary: Marvel has announced three animated specials continuing the Marvel Zombies storyline, slated for release in 2027, 2028, and 2029.
highlights: Three sequels confirmed: Marvel Zombies: The Winter Soldier (2027), Marvel Zombies: The Fist of Khonshu (2028), and Marvel Zombies: The Last Guardian (2029)
Director Bryan Andrews returns for all three specials
First special will explore Bucky Barnes' fate after the original What If? episode
marvel_confirms_three_sequels_its_most_u.why_it_matters: The expansions extend a popular animated horror franchise, offering new storylines and character developments for fans of the MCU’s alternate universe.

daredevil_born_again_s_ending_officially.headline: Daredevil: Born Again
daredevil_born_again_s_ending_officially.summary: Season 3 of Daredevil: Born Again has been confirmed as the series’ final season at New York Comic Con.
highlights: Season 3 will be the last season of the series, prompting audience boos at NYCC
The show’s conclusion is set for March 2027 on Disney+
Charlie Cox, Finn Jones, and Krysten Ritter reunited on stage, sparking fan hopes for a Defenders revival
daredevil_born_again_s_ending_officially.why_it_matters: The ending caps a popular MCU‑Netflix crossover while the cast reunion fuels speculation about future Defenders projects.

marvel_confirms_its_next_disney_tv_serie.headline: Zodiac
marvel_confirms_its_next_disney_tv_serie.summary: Marvel announced development of a new Disney+ series titled Zodiac, slated to begin filming next year and debut in 2028.
highlights: Confirmed at New York Comic-Con with an official logo reveal
Series will be a spy thriller potentially reviving S.H.I.E.L.D. in the MCU
Filming is set to start next year with a 2028 release on Disney+
marvel_confirms_its_next_disney_tv_serie.why_it_matters: The show could reintroduce S.H.I.E.L.D. and tie into post‑Secret Wars MCU storytelling.

nycc_dark_horse_reflects_their_manga_his.headline: Gantz Deluxe Edition
nycc_dark_horse_reflects_their_manga_his.summary: Dark Horse announced a deluxe edition of Hiroya Oku’s Gantz slated for release on April 6, 2027.
highlights: Deluxe edition will feature restored pages and premium materials
First English right‑to‑left format for the series
Announced during Dark Horse’s 40th anniversary NYCC panel
nycc_dark_horse_reflects_their_manga_his.why_it_matters: The edition caters to collectors and expands Gantz’s presence in the English‑language market.

here_u_are_anime_reveals_2nd_major_trail.headline: Here U Are
here_u_are_anime_reveals_2nd_major_trail.summary: Crunchyroll unveiled the second teaser trailer for the upcoming anime adaptation of D JUN's Here U Are webtoon.
highlights: Tomoe Makino will direct the series at Studio Rouseact
Aiki Kawamura handles series composition and Asami Hayakawa designs the characters
Shinya Kiyozuka composes the music
Yūki Inoue and Ryōta Suzuki voice the main leads Yang Yu and Huan Li
here_u_are_anime_reveals_2nd_major_trail.why_it_matters: The teaser confirms the series is in production and introduces key creative staff, building anticipation among fans of the popular webtoon.

myanimelist.net/news/74803489.headline: From Web Novel to Anime: The Evolution of The Remarried Empress

comisma_enters_agreement_akili_internati.headline: Zukyun x Bakyun
comisma_enters_agreement_akili_internati.summary: Comisma has partnered with Akili International to produce a live‑action film adaptation of the Zukyun x Bakyun manga.
highlights: The live‑action film agreement was announced by Comisma and Akili International
Seven Seas Entertainment holds the English license and will publish the first volume in September 2027
The manga ran on Comisma’s GANMA! platform from October 2023 to September 2025 and concluded with a fifth digital volume released on January 1, 2026
comisma_enters_agreement_akili_internati.why_it_matters: It marks the first major live‑action adaptation of the series, expanding its reach beyond the manga readership.

my_sword_saint_master_is_too_cute_live_a.headline: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With!
my_sword_saint_master_is_too_cute_live_a.summary: A teaser video revealed the anime’s cast and confirmed a January 2027 TV premiere.
highlights: Ai Kakuma voices Liza Parsandra and Hitomi Ueda serves as narrator
Masayoshi Nishida directs the series at Wolfsbane and Lightbox
Seven Seas Entertainment will release the manga in June 2027 under its Ghost Ship imprint
my_sword_saint_master_is_too_cute_live_a.why_it_matters: The project brings a popular rom‑com manga to TV, expanding its audience with a notable voice cast and dual‑studio collaboration.

the_most_depraved_comic_the_2000s_is_off.headline: Crossed
the_most_depraved_comic_the_2000s_is_off.summary: A trailer for the live‑action adaptation of Garth Ennis' ultra‑violent comic Crossed has been released.
highlights: The trailer was unveiled by Bloody Disgusting and directed by Rob Jabbaz, known for the cult horror film The Sadness
The film follows survivors Stan and Cindy as they flee the infected "Crossed" who bear a cross-shaped mark and act on their worst impulses
The trailer’s graphic imagery mirrors the comic’s brutal panels, confirming a faithful adaptation
Crossed was originally published in 2008 by Avatar Press, featuring contributions from writers like Alan Moore and Kieron Gillen
the_most_depraved_comic_the_2000s_is_off.why_it_matters: It marks the first confirmed cinematic portrayal of one of the most extreme comics of the 2000s, signaling a shift toward ultra‑graphic content in mainstream horror releases.

anime_trailer_guy_she_was_interested_202.headline: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All
anime_trailer_guy_she_was_interested_202.summary: The anime adaptation revealed its first trailer, expanded voice cast, and a January 8, 2027 premiere date.
highlights: Masashi Ishihama directs the series at studio CloverWorks
Opening theme will be Nirvana’s “Breed” as confirmed by Dave Grohl
Main cast includes Mariya Ise as Mitsuki Koga and Akari Kito as Aya Osawa
The series will stream worldwide on Crunchyroll
anime_trailer_guy_she_was_interested_202.why_it_matters: The project brings a popular award‑winning web manga to a global audience with a high‑profile staff and a notable rock soundtrack.

crunchyroll_hayate_line_digital_frontier.headline: Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of Around 15 Webtoons
crunchyroll_hayate_line_digital_frontier.summary: Crunchyroll, HAYATE and LINE Digital Frontier announced a partnership to adapt roughly 15 webtoons into anime series that will stream exclusively on Crunchyroll in select territories.
highlights: HAYATE, founded in March 2025, will lead planning and production with staff from Aniplex and Crunchyroll
HAYATE acquired studio Lay‑duce in April 2025 and is overseeing the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime
LINE Digital Frontier aims to produce 20 webtoon‑based anime adaptations this year after delivering 12 in 2024
Crunchyroll will stream the resulting anime exclusively in selected regions
crunchyroll_hayate_line_digital_frontier.why_it_matters: The collaboration significantly expands the pipeline of webtoon‑to‑anime adaptations, bolstering Crunchyroll’s exclusive content library.

avatar_prequel_tv_2026.headline: Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos
avatar_prequel_tv_2026.summary: Paramount+ has officially ordered the first‑ever Avatar prequel series, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos, set three generations before Aang.
highlights: The series will follow Avatar Kuruk, the tragic Water Tribe Avatar, during his youth
Co‑creators Bryan Konietzko and Michael Dante DiMartino will serve as showrunners
Avatar Studios will produce the series for Paramount+
Avatar: Seven Havens, the current series, was renewed for two additional seasons
avatar_prequel_tv_2026.why_it_matters: It expands the Avatar universe with a new era and returns its original creators to helm the story.

batman_part2_costume_2026.headline: Batman: Knightfall – Part 2: Knightquest
highlights: Costume overhaul shown in the first‑look motion poster
The sequel follows Batman: Knightfall – Part 1, continuing the R‑rated trilogy
Voice cast includes Anson Mount as Batman and Michael Mando as Bane
Directed by Jeff Wamester with a screenplay by Jeremy Adams
batman_part2_costume_2026.why_it_matters: The new design signals a fresh visual direction for DC’s high‑profile animated adaptation of the iconic Knightfall storyline.

firefly_wedding_manga_gets_live_action_a.headline: Firefly Wedding
firefly_wedding_manga_gets_live_action_a.summary: Oreko Tachibana's Firefly Wedding manga will receive a live‑action TV adaptation on Fuji TV in 2027.
highlights: The adaptation will air on Fuji TV's Noitama block on Fridays at 11:30 p.m.
Crunchyroll will stream the series concurrently as it airs in Japan.
Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and the series concludes with its 13th volume slated for October 19, 2026.
firefly_wedding_manga_gets_live_action_a.why_it_matters: It marks the first live‑action adaptation of the critically acclaimed romance‑drama manga, expanding its audience beyond print.

nycc_dreambound_webtoon_revealed_as_a_se.headline: Dreambound
nycc_dreambound_webtoon_revealed_as_a_se.summary: Dreambound, originally a Webtoon series, was unveiled at NYCC as a secret DC Vertigo comic and will appear as a flipbook in the upcoming print anthology Fanatic.
highlights: Revealed at New York Comic Con 2026 as part of DC Vertigo’s 20th‑anniversary panel
Created by Ro Stein and Ted Brandt, originally launched on Webtoon in early September 2026
Will be incorporated into the print anthology Fanatic by Grace Ellis and Hannah Templer as a flipbook
NYCC attendees received a Dreambound ashcan as promotional material
nycc_dreambound_webtoon_revealed_as_a_se.why_it_matters: The move bridges digital‑first storytelling with traditional print, expanding Vertigo’s creator‑driven lineup and giving Webtoon fans a physical collectible.

nycc_sakai_and_lee_put_a_new_spin_heroes.headline: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The First Ronin
nycc_sakai_and_lee_put_a_new_spin_heroes.summary: IDW announced a five‑issue miniseries written by Stan Sakai and illustrated by Soo Lee as a spiritual prequel to TMNT: The Last Ronin.
highlights: Written by legendary comic creator Stan Sakai and drawn by Bram Stoker Award‑winning artist Soo Lee
Set in 1600s Japan featuring General Kameyama and four yōkai‑turtle allies
Five‑issue series slated for release in March 2027
Also revealed TMNT: The Last Ronin III – Return for New York, the final chapter of the saga, for 2027
nycc_sakai_and_lee_put_a_new_spin_heroes.why_it_matters: The series expands TMNT lore with new mythology and high‑profile creators, appealing to fans of The Last Ronin and classic turtle stories.

avatar_seven_havens_just_two_more_season.headline: Avatar: Seven Havens
avatar_seven_havens_just_two_more_season.summary: Avatar: Seven Havens premiered on Paramount+ and has been officially renewed through Seasons 3 and 4.
highlights: First new Avatar animated series in twelve years debuted on Paramount+
Co‑creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko confirmed renewals for Seasons 3 and 4 at New York Comic Con
Book 1 episodes will roll out weekly throughout October 2026
avatar_seven_havens_just_two_more_season.why_it_matters: The early multi‑season renewal signals strong studio confidence in expanding the Avatar franchise for a new generation.

dc_absolute_justice_2027.headline: Absolute Justice
dc_absolute_justice_2027.summary: DC announced the five‑issue crossover event "Absolute Justice" set for April 2027.
highlights: Announced at New York Comic Con 2026 as part of the Absolute Universe line
Written by Jason Aaron with art by Juan Ferreyra
Features an Absolute Justice League lineup of Superman, Wonder Woman, Batman, Martian Manhunter, Jo Mullein and Flash
Will not disrupt ongoing Absolute titles and has no tie‑in issues
dc_absolute_justice_2027.why_it_matters: The event expands the popular Absolute imprint and reinforces DC’s market lead over Marvel.

marvel_nycc2026_mysterious_event_june202.headline: Marvel teases mysterious June 2027 event with “Tomorrow Is One Day Away”
marvel_nycc2026_mysterious_event_june202.summary: Marvel announced a cryptic June 2027 event during NYCC 2026, hinting at a major future storyline or publishing initiative.
highlights: Editor‑in‑Chief Stephen Wacker closed the NYCC Bullpen Bulletins panel with the tagline “Tomorrow Is One Day Away” for June 2027
The teaser graphic incorporates artwork from Amazing Spider‑Man #1000, X‑Men United, Thor #800, and the upcoming Captain Marvel series launching May 2027
No details were revealed about the nature of the event, leaving fans to speculate on a possible universe‑wide storyline or publishing push
marvel_nycc2026_mysterious_event_june202.why_it_matters: The tease signals a potentially significant Marvel Universe development that could shape upcoming titles and reader expectations.

nycc_marvel_comics_teases_any_relation_o.headline: Marvel Comics Teases “1 Day”
nycc_marvel_comics_teases_any_relation_o.summary: Marvel Editor‑In‑Chief Steve Wacker hinted at a new June 2027 project titled “1 Day” during the NYCC panel, sparking speculation about a possible Spider‑Man reset.
highlights: The tease was announced at New York Comic Con 2026 by Marvel’s new Editor‑In‑Chief Steve Wacker
Wacker urged fans to “save the date because no one is promised the future” for June 2027
The cryptic title “1 Day” has reignited discussion about the controversial 2007 storyline “One More Day”
No concrete details were provided, leaving the nature of the project open to speculation
nycc_marvel_comics_teases_any_relation_o.why_it_matters: A potential storyline affecting Spider‑Man’s marriage could reshape decades of continuity and influence future Marvel narratives.

nycc_yen_press_announces_kino_s_journey_.headline: Kino’s Journey Light Novel Print Edition
nycc_yen_press_announces_kino_s_journey_.summary: Yen Press announced a new print edition of the classic mid‑2000s light novel Kino’s Journey at NYCC 2026.
highlights: Announced as part of fourteen new licenses at Yen Press’s NYCC panel
Print edition adds the previously digital‑only light novel to Yen Press’s catalog
Included among other new titles such as Fate/strange Fake and The Girls Adrift Among the Stars
nycc_yen_press_announces_kino_s_journey_.why_it_matters: Brings a beloved classic light novel back into physical form for collectors and new readers alike.

marvel_crossover_crisis_of_faith_2027.headline: Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover: Crisis Of Faith
marvel_crossover_crisis_of_faith_2027.summary: Marvel announced a new Spider-Man crossover event titled Crisis Of Faith, slated for April 2027.
highlights: The crossover will feature both Miles Morales and Peter Parker in a "no holds barred" storyline.
Joe Kelly and Bryan Edward Hill, the regular writers of each series, will co‑write the event.
The story follows Peter Parker’s crisis after the Hellgate saga and Miles Morales challenging his decisions.
The event was revealed at the Spider‑Man panel during New York Comic Con 2026.
marvel_crossover_crisis_of_faith_2027.why_it_matters: It brings together Marvel’s two flagship Spider‑Man characters in a major crossover, promising significant narrative impact for both series.

swamp_thing_hallowed_ground_nycc_2026.headline: Swamp Thing: Hallowed Ground
swamp_thing_hallowed_ground_nycc_2026.summary: DC Next Level announced a new 2027 prestige horror Swamp Thing series at NYCC.
highlights: Steve Foxe and Riccardo Federici are teaming up for a standalone Swamp Thing story focusing on the Green and sacred human sites
The project is slated as a 2027 DC Comics prestige horror title
The announcement follows the recent release of the long‑delayed Swamp Thing 1989 material, reviving interest in the character’s metaphysical horror roots
swamp_thing_hallowed_ground_nycc_2026.why_it_matters: It marks a major new creative direction for Swamp Thing, pairing a horror‑savvy writer with a detailed artist to explore the character’s roots.

dr_stone_terraforming.headline: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING
dr_stone_terraforming.summary: A new sequel anime adapting the “TERRAFORMING” arc from volume 27 has entered production.
highlights: The sequel will continue the story after the TV anime’s finale on June 25, 2026
An announcement trailer featuring newly recorded dialogue from Senku was released
The project adapts the “TERRAFORMING” story from volume 27 of the manga
Creator Riichiro Inagaki and artist Boichi publicly confirmed the production
dr_stone_terraforming.why_it_matters: It extends the Dr. STONE narrative beyond the concluded TV series, giving fans more of Senku’s scientific adventures.

spider_punk_series_jan2027.headline: Spider-Punk (2027)
spider_punk_series_jan2027.summary: Marvel announced a new Spider-Punk comic series returning Hobie Brown, slated for January 2027.
highlights: Series announced at NYCC 2026 Spider-Man panel
Written by Cody Ziglar and illustrated by Justin Mason, the creators of the 2022 miniseries and 2024 sequel
Continues the storyline after the 2022 Spider-Punk miniseries and 2024 Spider-Punk: Arms Race
spider_punk_series_jan2027.why_it_matters: Reuniting the original creators signals a continued focus on Spider-Punk within Marvel's expanding Spider-Verse.

bob_s_burgers_confirms_hulu_new_holiday_.headline: Bob’s Burgers Holiday Short “On the Fort Day of Christmas”
bob_s_burgers_confirms_hulu_new_holiday_.summary: Bob’s Burgers will debut a new holiday short on Hulu on December 7, 2026.
highlights: The short is titled “On the Fort Day of Christmas.”
It will premiere on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ on December 7, 2026.
The release follows Fox’s shift of the series to a mid‑season schedule, delaying Season 17 to early 2027.
A first‑look clip was revealed at New York Comic Con 2026.
bob_s_burgers_confirms_hulu_new_holiday_.why_it_matters: The exclusive Hulu short keeps the franchise visible during the holiday season despite the broadcast schedule change.

dnd_dark_sun_nycc_2026.headline: Dungeons & Dragons: Dark Sun Graphic Novel Trilogy
dnd_dark_sun_nycc_2026.summary: Dark Horse and Wizards of the Coast announced a new three‑book hardcover graphic novel series set in the Dark Sun setting at NYCC.
highlights: The first volume, Dungeons & Dragons: Dark Sun Volume 1, will serve as a companion to the new Dark Sun tabletop RPG books and the Season of Survival line.
The series is written by Dan Abnett and illustrated by Nil Vendrell, known for work on Guardians of the Galaxy and The Witcher respectively.
The hardcover is scheduled for release on April 20 2027.
The story follows Tikat, a Thri‑kreen gladiator, in a brutal survival tale across the wastelands of Athas.
dnd_dark_sun_nycc_2026.why_it_matters: It provides the first official graphic‑novel tie‑in to the revamped Dark Sun RPG, expanding the setting for both tabletop and comic fans.

bleedingcool.com/comics/nycc-marvel-anno.headline: What’s the Next Big Spider‑Man Showdown?

naruto_shadow_rising.headline: Naruto: Shadow Rising
naruto_shadow_rising.summary: Masashi Kishimoto announced a new Naruto manga titled Naruto: Shadow Rising at New York Comic Con 2026.
highlights: The manga was revealed during the Naruto: What's Next? panel at NYCC 2026 with a teaser video
It is part of the three‑year Project Rasengan, alongside a crossover anime, mobile game, and card game
More details will be shared at Jump Festa 2027
naruto_shadow_rising.why_it_matters: The new series revives the original Naruto storyline, offering fresh content for long‑time fans and expanding the franchise’s future roadmap.

dcu_green_hero_show.headline: Green Arrow & Black Canary Series in Development
dcu_green_hero_show.summary: DC Studios is reportedly developing a Green Arrow and Black Canary series for the DCU following the success of the Lanterns project.
highlights: Report from Fortress of DC cites DC Studios developing the series
The project could explore the long‑standing romance between Oliver Queen and Dinah Lance
No official details on platform, creative team, or release timeline have been released
dcu_green_hero_show.why_it_matters: A dedicated series would finally give fans a proper on‑screen portrayal of one of DC's most iconic superhero couples.

marvel_kadokawa_venom_lethal_protector.headline: Venom: Lethal Protector
marvel_kadokawa_venom_lethal_protector.summary: Marvel and Kadokawa announced the manga Venom: Lethal Protector by Peperon on the KadoComi digital platform at New York Comic Con 2026.
highlights: Venom joins a five‑title Marvel × Kadokawa manga lineup including Deadpool, Iron Man, Spider‑Gwen and Spider‑Man
The story follows Eddie Brock’s origin, echoing the classic comic debut of the symbiote
The manga will be released digitally on Kadokawa’s KadoComi platform
The collaboration was revealed during NYCC 2026 following Marvel’s new Asia Originals initiative
marvel_kadokawa_venom_lethal_protector.why_it_matters: It expands Marvel’s presence in the Japanese manga market and offers fans a fresh take on a classic anti‑hero.

spider_man_s_coolest_disney_series_confi.headline: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man (Season 2)

midnight_spider_man_makes_uncle_ben_s_de.why_it_matters: It reshapes a foundational Spider‑Man moment, offering fans a fresh, horror‑driven perspective on the hero’s origin.

the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.headline: The Rings of Power Season 3 Trailer
the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.summary: Amazon released the first trailer for Season 3 of The Rings of Power, revealing Sauron forging the One Ring.
highlights: The trailer shows Sauron in his iconic armored form forging the One Ring
Season 3 will debut on Prime Video on November 11, 2026 with a batch‑release schedule
Showrunner Patrick McKay says the upcoming season takes a darker path than the previous two
The season promises major battles featuring Elves, Dwarves and Men against Sauron’s forces
the_rings_power_finally_reveals_the_stor.why_it_matters: The forging of the One Ring is a pivotal moment in Tolkien’s legendarium, and its on‑screen debut promises a major narrative climax for fans of the series.

tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.headline: Tom Taylor and Mikel Janín to Leave Detective Comics in 2027
tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.summary: Tom Taylor and artist Mikel Janín will conclude their run on Detective Comics with the six‑issue Clark Kent: Murderer arc, ending their tenure in 2027.
highlights: Their final story begins with Detective Comics #1115 and runs through #1116, ending the arc in early 2027
The creators have been on the title since Detective Comics #1090, roughly a two‑and‑a‑half year run
DC Comics has not confirmed any crossover connections with the main Batman title
tom_taylor_mikel_janin_dc_departure_2027.why_it_matters: Their departure closes a notable era that featured high‑profile storylines like the anti‑fear virus and the Clark Kent murder mystery, impacting Batman’s narrative direction.

dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.headline: Dark Horse February 2027 Solicits Reveal New Baldur’s Gate III, Barbie, and Blue Eye Samurai Launches
dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.summary: Dark Horse Comics announced its February 2027 solicit list, debuting Baldur’s Gate III #1, Barbie: Together in Time #1, and Blue Eye Samurai: Cry of the Yurei #1 among other titles.
highlights: Baldur’s Gate III #1 launches February 24, 2027, written by Alyssa Wong with art by Vincenzo Carratù and Elisabetta D’Amico
Barbie: Together in Time #1 arrives February 10, 2027, penned by Ben Kahn and illustrated by Natalie Nardozza
Blue Eye Samurai: Cry of the Yurei #1 debuts February 3, 2027, created by K. Perkins, Mike Johnson and artist Aviv Or
dark_horse_full_february_solicits_baldur.why_it_matters: The lineup expands Dark Horse’s portfolio with high‑profile video‑game adaptations and a fresh Barbie adventure, signaling continued cross‑media growth.

boom_studios_full_january_solicits_and_s.headline: Hellraiser: Hellbound Hearts #1
boom_studios_full_january_solicits_and_s.summary: Boom Studios announced the January 2027 launch of Hellraiser: Hellbound Hearts #1, a new ongoing series expanding Clive Barker’s horror franchise.
highlights: Written by Mike Costa with art by Jan Bazaldua, marking a new creative team for the Hellraiser mythos
Introduces a fresh storyline where friends battle to keep the Puzzle Box sealed amid multiple boxes and heightened horror
First issue is 24 pages, priced at $4.99, and goes on sale January 6, 2027
boom_studios_full_january_solicits_and_s.why_it_matters: The series revives the iconic Hellraiser brand with fresh creators, promising a modern take on its classic horror themes.

image_comics_full_january_solicits_and_s.headline: Image Comics January 2027 Solicits
image_comics_full_january_solicits_and_s.summary: Image Comics released its full January 2027 solicit list, unveiling several new series and miniseries.
highlights: New titles include Lake Totem, Exquisite Corpses: Book of the Dead, Gehenna, The Territory, Innen and Transformers: Bumblebee – Lost Planet
Skybound expands with Transformers: Bumblebee – Lost Planet and new G.I. Joe and M.A.S.K. issues
Ongoing flagship series such as Spawn, Void Rivals, Witchblade and Feral return in the lineup
Deluxe hardcovers and trade collections for Transformers, Terminal and Spawn are also highlighted
image_comics_full_january_solicits_and_s.why_it_matters: The solicit introduces fresh creator‑driven projects and expands popular licensed properties, signaling a robust upcoming publishing slate for Image.

new_marvel_s_blade_report_indicates_the_.headline: Marvel’s Blade Video Game
new_marvel_s_blade_report_indicates_the_.summary: A reported investigation suggests the upcoming Marvel Blade game at Arkane Studios faces possible cancellation as the studio races to find a buyer by November 13.
highlights: Arkane Studios has until November 13 to secure a new owner or risk closure by Xbox
The Blade game was reportedly on track for a 2027 release before the studio’s uncertain future
If cancelled, years of development on the superhero title would be scrapped
Blade’s development follows a recent failed Marvel movie project starring Mahershala Ali
new_marvel_s_blade_report_indicates_the_.why_it_matters: The potential loss of Blade would remove a highly anticipated Marvel game from the market and could signal broader instability for Xbox’s studio portfolio.

the_apothecary_diaries_director_breaks_s.headline: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
the_apothecary_diaries_director_breaks_s.summary: Season 3 of The Apothecary Diaries is currently airing, with the director detailing major artistic and narrative shifts as the story moves westward.
highlights: The third season adapts volume 5 of the light novel, showing Maomao working as an apothecary at Verdigris House
Director Akinori Fudesaka emphasized new western‑inspired color schemes, clothing and architecture for the season
The season is split into two cours, with the second cour slated for April 2027 in the Spring lineup
the_apothecary_diaries_director_breaks_s.why_it_matters: The changes signal a broader narrative expansion beyond the Rear Palace, affecting visual design and plot direction for fans.

avengers_doomsday_pedro_pascal.headline: Alien (new film)
avengers_doomsday_pedro_pascal.summary: A new Alien movie is in early development, focusing on the android David from the prequel series rather than being a sequel to Alien: Romulus.
highlights: The project is being written by Aaron Guzikowski, who previously worked with Ridley Scott on the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves.
The film will tie into the 2010 prequel sequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant, using David as the connective element.
Michael Fassbender is not formally attached and no director has been announced, indicating the film is still in its early stages.
The planned sequel to Alien: Romulus is currently in limbo, making this new direction unexpected for the franchise.
avengers_doomsday_pedro_pascal.why_it_matters: It signals a shift back to the prequel storyline and could revive interest in the controversial David character for fans of the franchise.

jp_gov_corp_anime_manga_expansion_2026.headline: MCM London Comic Con October 2026 Pre‑Opening Walk Highlights
jp_gov_corp_anime_manga_expansion_2026.summary: A pre‑opening walkthrough at MCM London Comic Con showcased major pop‑culture displays such as Ultimate Grogu, Bandai Gundam, Tamagotchi and Final Fantasy.
highlights: Press members filmed a TikTok walkthrough of the show floor before doors opened on October 2026
Featured large‑scale displays including an Ultimate Grogu figure, a towering Bandai Gundam, and a Tamagotchi vs Dungeon Crawler Carl showcase
The event continues its growth as the UK’s largest pop‑culture convention, now occupying the entire ExCeL London venue
MCM London Comic Con, founded in 2002, is now part of Reed Exhibitions’ portfolio alongside NYCC and ECCC
jp_gov_corp_anime_manga_expansion_2026.why_it_matters: The scale of the displays underscores MCM’s status as a key hub for comics, toys and gaming in the UK market.

the_dungeon_crawler_carl_webtoon_series_.headline: Dungeon Crawler Carl
the_dungeon_crawler_carl_webtoon_series_.summary: Vault Comics will publish a physical comic adaptation of the Dungeon Crawler Carl WEBTOON series in early 2027.
highlights: Adaptation scheduled for January 2027
Adapted by Tevagah with art by Kuzomari
Created by AETHON, Actus and Laurel Pursuit Studios
Published by Vault Comics
the_dungeon_crawler_carl_webtoon_series_.why_it_matters: Brings the popular prose series to print, expanding its audience beyond digital readers.

tangles_trailer_2026_10_23.headline: Tangles
tangles_trailer_2026_10_23.summary: The trailer for the animated adaptation of Sarah Leavitt’s graphic memoir Tangles has been released.
highlights: Directed by Leah Nelson in her feature debut and co‑written by Leavitt
Voice cast includes Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis‑Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston and Seth Rogen
Animated by Vancouver studio Giant Ant, known for Animaniacs revival and Hilda and the Mountain King
Will open in select theaters Jan 15 and nationwide Jan 22, 2027
tangles_trailer_2026_10_23.why_it_matters: It brings a personal, award‑winning graphic memoir to the big screen with a high‑profile cast and studio.

apothecary_diaries_film_trailer_2026_10_.headline: Oni Press January 2027 Solicits Reveal New Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake and Dr. Syn Comics
apothecary_diaries_film_trailer_2026_10_.summary: Oni Press announced its January 2027 lineup, debuting Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake #1 and Dr. Syn #1 among other titles.
highlights: Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake #1 launches on January 13, 2027, written by Jenna Ayoub with art by Damali Beatty
Dr. Syn #1 arrives on January 6, 2027, created by Michael E. Uslan, Steven S. DeKnight, and artist Sebastián Cabrol
Bulletproof Coffin returns with a giant‑size issue slated for January 13, 2027
Tortured Hearts 2 and an Artists From The Abyss one‑shot by Sami Kivelä are also part of the slate
apothecary_diaries_film_trailer_2026_10_.why_it_matters: The lineup brings beloved franchises like Adventure Time back to comics and introduces a fresh origin story for Dr. Syn, exciting both fans and collectors.

attack_titan_and_jujutsu_kaisen_studio_s.headline: Vinland Saga Season 3
attack_titan_and_jujutsu_kaisen_studio_s.summary: Creator Makoto Yukimura confirmed there has been no progress on a third season of the Vinland Saga anime.
highlights: The manga concluded last year, but the anime’s third season remains unannounced.
Yukimura debunked earlier rumors that Season 3 was in development.
Neither Kodansha nor MAPPA have provided any update since Season 2.
The production committee includes Twin Engine, Kodansha, Production I.G., and MAPPA, which can lengthen development cycles.
attack_titan_and_jujutsu_kaisen_studio_s.why_it_matters: Fans of the critically acclaimed seinen series are left without a timeline for the story’s continuation.

keenspot_january_solicits_mark_spears_th.headline: The Crying Boy Vol. 1 (Keenspot)
keenspot_january_solicits_mark_spears_th.summary: Keenspot’s January 2027 solicitations feature a collected edition of The Crying Boy, timed with news of a major motion‑picture adaptation.
highlights: The Crying Boy Vol. 1 collects the acclaimed four‑issue horror series and is slated for release on January 13 2027.
The collection is highlighted alongside the announcement that the series is in development as a major motion picture with producer Carter Swan.
Keenspot also announced a fourth printing of Mark Spears’ Monsters #2 in a Black, White & Dead Edition for January 6 2027.
keenspot_january_solicits_mark_spears_th.why_it_matters: The trade paperback capitalizes on heightened interest from the upcoming film, expanding the series’ audience beyond comic readers.

rocketeer_rights_loss_disney_2026.headline: The Rocketeer
rocketeer_rights_loss_disney_2026.summary: The Rocketeer Trust has filed a notice to reclaim the rights to The Rocketeer from Disney, with termination set for June 12, 2028.
highlights: The Rocketeer Trust, represented by creator Dave Stevens' sister, filed the termination notice on June 11, 2026
Disney will retain distribution rights to existing productions but cannot produce new sequels or reboots without a new agreement after June 12, 2028
Previous revival attempts, including a 2019 Disney Junior series and stalled live‑action projects, have failed to secure Disney’s continued control
The termination mirrors recent copyright reclamations such as Disney’s loss of Roger Rabbit rights in 2025
rocketeer_rights_loss_disney_2026.why_it_matters: The loss of the franchise could open The Rocketeer to new creative partners and potentially revive the property outside Disney’s control.

rebellion_january_solicits_ad_50th_year_.headline: 2000 AD 50th Anniversary & Judge Dredd Megazine #500
rebellion_january_solicits_ad_50th_year_.summary: Rebellion’s January 2027 solicitations celebrate 2000 AD’s 50th anniversary with a special, new Progs, a Visual History hardcover, and the landmark Judge Dredd Megazine #500.
highlights: Judge Dredd Megazine #500 is a 100‑page issue featuring a double‑length Dark Judges story with Anthrax members Scott Ian and Charlie Benante and the debut of
The 2000 AD 50th Anniversary Special brings new stories from iconic characters like Judge Dredd, Robo‑Hunter and Nikolai Dante, plus a surprise series return
A new Visual History hardcover chronicles five decades of 2000 AD’s influential titles and creators
Judge Dredd Compact Crimes Volume 1 collects the character’s earliest adventures in a new trade‑paper format
rebellion_january_solicits_ad_50th_year_.why_it_matters: The anniversary releases mark half a century of one of Britain’s most influential comics, offering both longtime fans and newcomers a curated entry point.

the_morning_after_an_open_bar_the_night_.headline: Open Bar at MCM London Comic Con
the_morning_after_an_open_bar_the_night_.summary: ReedPOP hosted an industry mixer with a free open bar at MCM London Comic Con’s Waterfront venue.
highlights: Representatives from DC, Image, Dark Horse, Forbidden Planet and Diamond UK attended the open bar
It was the first open bar at a British comic convention in many years
Creator David Baillie helped spread the word, leading to a lively after‑hours scene
the_morning_after_an_open_bar_the_night_.why_it_matters: The event highlights a rare social gathering for UK comic creators and publishers, fostering networking and community spirit.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Oishinbo # Oishinbo Cooking Manga Receives New TV Anime Series
...
Tetsu Kariya and Akira Hanasaki’s long-running Oishinbo cooking manga series is receiving a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo. The new anime project was announced during a stage event at ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 celebrating Shin-Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary.
...
The Oishinbo manga series, which is written by Kariya and drawn by Hanasaki, has been serialized in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Spirits magazine since October 1983. It has been in an indefinite hiatus since May 2014. A total of 111 tankobon volumes have been published in Japan as of December 2014.
...
The manga previously inspired a TV anime series from Shin-Ei Animation from 1988 to 1992, as well as two anime films from Studio Deen in 1992 and 1993, respectively. A live-action film adaptation was also released in 1996. The long-running Oishinbo cooking manga will receive a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo. Announced at the ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 celebrating Shin‑Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary The project is titled Shin Oishinbo and will revive the classic food‑themed series No premiere date, cast, staff, or animation studio has been confirmed yet

Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha, Hana's shikigami that rests on her hair like an ornament
Taihi Kimura as Aoi, a shikigami in human form created by Hana
M.A.O as Miyabi, another shikigami in human form created by Hana

Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider‑Man Season 2 Prequel Comic Marvel Comics has revealed season two of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man will receive a four-issue prequel comic ahead of its premiere next year. Writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur, who previously teamed up on the prequel for the first season of the animated Disney+ series in 2024, will reunite for this installment, which picks up after the finale, when Norman Osborn (voiced by Colman Domingo) obtained a sample of a symbiote.
The full synopsis says, “Your favorite web-slinger is back! Peter Parker is ready to save the world thwip by thwip! But things aren’t perfect. He’s been drifting away from his friends. And Norman Osborn may be out of the spider business, but Harry doesn’t think things are over just yet. Something’s happening at Oscorp, and Spidey and his friends need to figure out what it is!”
Gage comments, “I’m beyond excited to return to the world of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man! Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show’s continuity.”

publication_fingerprints.headline: Akarui Mirai
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akarui Mirai Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025. Kaihō writes the story while Kurageso draws the art. Houbunsha shipped the second compiled book volume on July 10.
The manga centers on Mirai, a girl who is not very good at socializing. A foul-mouthed AI from the future tells her she is going to die alone if she doesn't change, but Mirai isn't sure exactly how she is supposed to make friends.
Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Manga Time Kirara Forward in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. Kaihō and Chiba launchedGakkō Gurashi! ~Otayori~, a sequel to the manga, in Manga Time Kirara Forward in June 2020, and ended it in August 2021.
Kaihō is also known for writing scripts for anime, and wrote the anime adaptation of his School-Live! manga. He was also the head writer on both Danganronpa 3 anime (as well as their "Hope Arc" special), was co-writer alongside Makoto Fukami on the anime adaptation of Fukami's Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka manga, and was also co-writer on the Akudama Drive original anime alongside its director Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward. publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast The official website for the anime of Nagano's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25. The revival rebroadcast will focus on episodes early in the anime's run, as well as episodes that are connected to the recent Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu (Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island) anime film.
The Chiikawaanimepremiered in April 2022, and it previously aired every Friday withinFuji TV's morning news and entertainment program Mezamashi Terebi, before it began airing twice a week on Tuesdays and Fridays in April 2023. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, and is streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles. ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV began streaming a selection of 20 episodes from the anime on August 20.
Child actress Haruka Aoki (Liza in the Japanese dub of Mighty Express) voices the titular character Chiikawa as her first television anime voice acting role. Child actor Makoto Tanaka (Okko's Inn) voices Hachiware. Ari Ozawa voices Usagi.

The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira's Mission: Yozakura Family (Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen) manga revealed a new promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals five new cast members for the anime.
The new cast members include:
Hōchū Ōtsuka as Alexandryu
Miku Itō as Shura
Yumiri Hanamori as Cyber Demon Lord Giga
Sumire Uesaka as Dr. Mozu
Naomi Shindoh as Hulang
The announcement also revealed the character Kosmos Akizakura (seen below), but did not reveal the voice actor for the character.
The second part of the second season will premiere on MBS, TBS, and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).
The rock band Humbreaders performs the new anime's opening theme song "Forever Song," and dance and vocal group KID PHENOMENON performs the new ending theme song "I'm Still Breathing."
Disney describes the anime's story:
High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 News
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 Anime Returns for 3rd Part in July 2027, Clayman's Revenge Spinoff Anime Debuts in April
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
The staff for the fourth That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken) anime season revealed on Friday that the anime will return for its third cours (quarter of a year) in July 2027. In addition, the staff revealed that Wataru Kajika's That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge) spinoff manga will get a television anime that will debut in April 2027.
Takehito Koyasu is returning to the franchise to voice Clayman.
Kentarō Sugimoto (episode director for Blue Lock, Laid-Back Camp TV 3) is directing the spinoff anime at 8-Bit. Yūji Haibara, who handled graphic design for previous entries in the franchise, is overseeing the series scripts. Asumi Hashimoto (sub-character design for The irregular at magic high school TV 3) and Hideki Sakai (chief animation director for previous entries in the franchise) are designing the characters.

Horror Collector The 13th season of American Horror Story, simply subtitled 13, debuted its first three episodes yesterday, Sept. 24, and it's already breaking records with audiences — just not the types of records the series was hoping for. Season 13 currently has the lowest Rotten Tomatoes audience score of all previous seasons.
American Horror Story's 13th season has a 32% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. A critic score has not yet been compiled, but the show overall across seasons has a 77% critic score and a 64% audience score. Aside from 13, only four other seasons of the horror anthology series have garnered below a 60% Rotten Tomatoes audience score, with NYC (Season 11) at 42%, Double Feature (Season 10) at 50%, Cult (Season 7) at 52%, and Roanoke (Season 6) at 57%.
Season 13 Was Highly Anticipated
Unlike previous seasons of American Horror Story, which are mostly standalone stories, possibly with some tangential connection to a previous season, 13 connects to almost every tale told previously in the anthology series.

The new short anime is titled Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA, and is a direct sequel to the 1998 Future GPX Cyber Formula Sin anime.
Character designer Hirokazu Hisayuki and chief mechanical animation director Satoshi Shigeta drew the below poster for the new anime short.
Series director Mitsuo Fukuda is overseeing the new "movie edition" of Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal.

Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:
“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”
Series creator Osamu Nishi also commented:
“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”
You can watch the announcement video below.
The Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun anime is based on Osamu Nishi’s manga serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion, which has 50 volumes published as of September 8, 2026. The anime premiered in 2019. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story:

One Piece ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180, this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5. Yuichi Nakamura was revealed as the voice of Loki, and he made his debut in the Elbaph Arc alongside the cast for the Knights of God.
Today’s episode is titled “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’” and it is now streaming on Crunchyroll. You can see the end card for the episode below.
ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.
The anime also debuted new theme songs for the ongoing arc. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song is “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.

Long-Running Anime Series with 100+ Episodes Highlighted by CBR There is no shortage of outstanding anime series that don’t need more than a dozen episodes to fully captivate their audiences. However, considering how many of the medium’s all-time fan-favorite titles span hundreds of episodes, there’s no denying that ambitious, long-running anime series have their intrinsic appeal.
Long anime series are not for everyone; they are a substantial time commitment and seldom manage to keep their quality consistent without losing momentum or falling back on filler. However, among them, there exist remarkable examples of long-term storytelling that make sticking around for 100+ episodes worth it, to the point of viewers wishing these adventures could go on forever.

The Mummy 4 Production is underway on The Mummy 4 ahead of the film's release in 2027. While the long wait continues for the sequel, new images have revealed a first look at Rachel Weisz's long-awaited return to the franchise.
Amid filming in the UK, Weisz was spotted filming scenes for her return as Evelyn O'Connell in The Mummy 4. Images of her in full costume were taken and have been quickly spreading online. Fans are very excited to see the photos, and it's no wonder why they are going viral. This is the first time Weisz has been seen in the role of Evelyn since appearing in the second Mummy movie in 2001, at which point she exited the franchise.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz Finally Reunite
The Mummy 4, which has not yet had its official title announced, reunites Weisz with franchise star Brendan Fraser. It's believed that the new sequel will ignore the third installment of the franchise, 2008's The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor. After Weisz played Evelyn in 1999's The Mummy and 2001's The Mummy Returns, she did not return for the third film. Her role was recast with Maria bello taking over.

Tetsuya Chiba Puts Hinemosu Notari Nikki Manga on Hiatus Due to Poor Health
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
This year's 19th issue of Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine announced on Friday that Tetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will go on hiatus due to Chiba's poor health. The magazine's editorial staff stated that Chiba is eager to resume the manga's serialization as soon as possible, but the editorial department will prioritize Chiba's health and recovery.
In a separate statement by Chiba, he stated that the severe summer heat might be the cause of him feeling under the weather. Chiba added that he will focus on recovering to get back to drawing manga again. He apologizes for the worry he has caused, and asks for the readers' patience as he takes some time to recover.
Chiba launched the autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. AD Police Files (1990) 4K Restoration Bubblegum Crisis was one of the premier cyberpunk anime franchises of its day, known for its signature, almost sacrilegious use of bright colors and a pop music-esque aesthetic within the genre. Now, its contentious sequel is getting a modernized update, and the upgraded version finally has a release date.
AD Police Files was known for being very different compared to Bubblegum Crisis, but it's since become a cult classic in its own right. A modern 4K restoration of the 1990s OVA is on the way, offering viewers a better glimpse at its grit and gore. The newly released trailer is just a taste of how beautiful it still is, and the 4K edition is the version fans have waited over three decades for.
One of the Most Brutal '90s Cyberpunk OVAs Gets a 4K Upgrade
Announced at Anime Expo 2026 by AnimeEigo, the 4K version of AD Police Files comes from the OVA's original negative. This was one of five announcements at the event, though it's easily the most notable.
Set to be released as a Blu-ray and UHD combo pack, this version of AD Police Files will include the original Japanese dub (with English subtitles), the US English dub, the UK English dub and more. publication_fingerprints.headline: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
The voice cast consists of:
- Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno
- Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya
- Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai
- Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno
Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.
Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

Pokémon Winds & Waves Regional Dex Reveal Pokémon Winds and Waves likely won't be receiving any additional updates until early 2027. Thankfully, through various sources, both official and unofficial, quite a bit is known about the Generation 10 games, especially where the Pokémon are concerned.
Between old favorites and new friends, a total of 54 Pokémon have been revealed as part of the Regional Dex for Pokémon Winds and Waves. This list includes some obvious suspects, some more out there choices fans might not expect and, of course, already beloved additions to the franchise like the new Starter Trio, Pombon, Browt, and Gecqua.
54 Pokémon Officially Confirmed For Pokémon Winds and Waves
The Pokémon most prominently featured in the announced trailer for Pokémon Winds and Waves were, unsurprisingly, the new Starter Trio and the franchise's eternal mascot. Pombon, the Fire-type, Browt, the Grass-type, and Gecqua, the Water-type, have quickly won the hearts of fans, with fans in mass speculating about what their evolutions will look like. Pikachu, meanwhile, will not only be catchable as always, but two specific Pikachus are being featured as prominent characters in the games.

publication_fingerprints.headline: New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026 We spend a lot of time reminding people of the importance of bringing new readers into libraries, especially those in their younger years. Through them, we get a sense of what moves a community, what interests them or worries them or even makes them dream. It’s simple, libraries inform and reveal the cultural waylines of a people. The more readers we get, the more we know about what’s occupying our minds.
One group of readers that doesn’t always get the same level of attention but is just as crucial to the readership conversation are librarians, the people who curate and purchase the books we can check out at our local book temples. Their ability to engage with the wide range of genres, formats, and styles largely dictates what’s available on shelves. They are among some of the most voracious readers in existence.
The New York Public Library has put together a list of the best new comics of 2026 based on librarian input and feedback. It’s a special list as it offers a glimpse into the reading habits, intellectual leanings, and potential fandoms shared among NYC’s book ambassadors. As such, it is an infectious selection of comics.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yūichi Nakamura Viz Media's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!
The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.
Hokazono debuted the Kagurabachi manga in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 12th compiled volume in Japan on September 4. Yagami previously performed an ending theme song for the 1983 Final Yamato film.
The company also unveiled a rainbow-colored visual featuring the characters:
The films' character designer Nobuteru Yūki drew the main visual (pictured right).
The film will open in theaters in Japan on October 30. The overall anime is premiering as seven films. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime under the title Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199.

Street Fighters (The Asylum) After the official trailer for The Asylum‘s Street Fighters, the mockbuster film is out now. The flick arrives on digital on October 2— just two weeks before Capcom‘s big-budget Street Fighter film hits theaters on October 16.
For those unversed, The Asylum specializes in low-budget films that copy the titles and release dates of major Hollywood blockbusters. Street Fighters inevitably serves as a mockbuster to capitalize on Legendary and Paramount’s big-budget Street Fighter movie.
Directed by Brian Nowak from a script penned by Jacob Cooney and Jason White, this knockoff film sees the world’s best martial artists gather for a championship organized by a mysterious group, only to realize that they are fighting for their lives against a sinister plot.
The plot of the original game-based Street Fighter, on the other hand, reads, “Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. publication_fingerprints.headline: Berserk Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan Statue
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Berserk Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan Statue The Berserk franchise is no stranger to high-end collectibles, particularly those that perfectly showcase the brand's sometimes "racy" elements. Such is the case with the newest creation from Prime 1 Studio, which is a truly striking work of art.
Coming in at a 1/4 scale, the Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan: The Princess of the Uterine Sea is based mostly on her first appearance in the Berserk manga, with the visuals as harrowing as they are breathtaking. While not the first time that the company has produced a statue for the character, this one is a completely new sculpt.
Now available for pre-order and ready to rise within the next two years, the DX version of this collectible is one that fans will want to hurry and summon.
Berserk's Nearly 3-Foot Slan Statue Recreates Her Harrowing Eclipse Appearance
Based on her first appearance as a member of the God Hand, Ultimate Premium Masterline Slan: The Princess of the Uterine Sea evokes her as if she truly is appearing during the Eclipse. The most prominent part of the statue is her gigantic black wings, with these subtly creating a silhouette around her as they reach into the base.

Alice Oseman's Heartstopper Mini-Comics Get A Full Colour Hardcover
Alice Oseman's Heartstopper Mini-Comics are to get the full colour hardcover treatment from Hachette next year
While Alice Oseman's best-selling Heartstopper YA graphic novels were coming out from Hachette, based on her earlier webcomics and self-published comics, Alice Oseman kept putting out mini-comics set in the Heartstopper world as well, though they were much harder to come by. But that was then.
Now, Hachette Children's Group has announced Heartstopper: The Mini-Comics, a new full-colour collection of Oseman's mini-comics that includes two exclusive, brand-new stories. It continues Hachette's long-running partnership with Oseman, which began when the publisher acquired the print rights to the series after its successful webcomic and Kickstarter origins. Heartstopper follows the relationship between Nick Nelson and Charlie Spring and their circle of friends, and has become a global phenomenon across comics, television, and publishing. Volume 6, the final main instalment of the core series, was released in 2026. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. Kodansha USA describes the story:
Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.
Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.
Mokuba Matsu's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha's Palcy app. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

Kien Aien's story of youths taking on the coming apocalypse
The "Dengeki Bunko Fall Festival Online 2026" announced on Saturday that Kien Aien's Kochira, Shūmatsu Teitai Iinkai. (This Is the End Stagnation Committee.) light novel series has an anime in the works.
The story imagines if our world is actually in the middle of an apocalypse, unbeknownst to most people. Weird creatures beneath Tokyo's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail perched on the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord who looks like a beautiful girl …. Yet, in the underbelly of society, there are boys and girls who fight the coming apocalypse while giving it the middle finger. They can't cancel the apocalypse, and they can only delay it. Still, they take their arms into battle. Why? To them, this is just day-to-day life, a ritual festival every day for the young.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Batman – Part II Following multiple days, production on The Batman Part II is finally underway. While it won't be hitting the big screen until 2028, images taken from the set have revealed the first look at Robert Pattinson's return as Bruce Wayne.
The photos, which have been spreading on social media, appear to be from a scene where Pattinson's Bruce Wayne faces a crowd of angry protesters in Gotham. They seem to be no fans of Bruce after the events of The Batman, with people holding signs with messages like, "Death to billionaires." Members of the press are also taking photos of the secret vigilante as he is escorted through the crowd by security. Along with revealing a look at Pattinson back as Bruce, the images also hint at the unrest in the city when The Batman Part II picks up.
Robert Pattinson Will Be Joined by Other Familiar Faces
Pattinson is one of several stars of the first movie confirmed to return for The Batman Part II. He'll be joined by Jeffrey Wright as James Gordon, Andy Serkis as Alfred Pennyworth, and Colin Farrell as The Penguin. It is rumored that Barry Keoghan will also return as the Joker, but that hasn't been confirmed. Zoë Kravitz is not expected to appear in the film afte The sequel to Matt Reeves' 2022 film is slated for an October 3, 2025 theatrical release. The Apothecary Diaries Anime Returns to Universal Studios Japan
posted on 2026-10-03 23:59 EDT by Ken Iikura-Gross
Join Maomao & Jinshi for an all-new attraction at the theme park
The Apothecary Diaries anime series and Universal Studios Japan (USJ) announced on Thursday that the anime is returning to the theme park for an all-new attraction. The new attraction is set to open on February 10, 2027 with a story set during the events of The Apothecary Diaries movie (which is opening this December).
The anime and USJ previously collaborated between July 1, 2025 and January 4, 2026 with a “Mystery Walk” attraction (where guests solved a mystery behind a panacea) and three limited-time dishes.
The Apothecary Diaries anime's first season premiered in October 2023, followed by a second season in January 2025. A third television anime season premiered this week for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere next April.

Take Charge of My Heart The web novel-based live-action Korean seriesTake Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.

Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.

Civil War II #3 – The Death of the Hulk (June 2016) In every Look Back, we examine a comic book issue from 10/25/50 years ago (plus a wild card every month with a fifth week in it). This time around, I'm a bit late as I look at July 2016's shocking death of the Hulk during the Civil War II crossover event.
In the last decade or so, comic book fans have grown accustomed to the corporate synchronicity between the world of comic books and the world of comic book FILMS, where comic book companies figure that it makes sense to tie the events of the comic books to the events of the very popular movies based on their characters. There tends not to be as much of an overlap as you would think, but it is totally reasonable for the companies to still want to try it (after all, there was a HUGE boom in Batman comic book sales when the Batman movie came out, so why NOT chase that hope?).
Therefore, when Captain America: Civil War came out, loosely adapting the hit Marvel crossover event, it made sense to do a sequel to that event, and while Civil War II definitely didn't hit the same way as the original event, it still ended up having a major impact on the Marvel Universe, especially with the death of the Hulk in June 2016's Civil War II #3 by B In July 2016, Civil War II #3 depicted the controversial death of Bruce Banner, sparking major debate in the Marvel Universe. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Zoids: Chaotic Century manga to conclude with new chapters in 2027 Zoids: Chaotic Century is officially set to continue with brand-new chapters after more than two decades.
Per Inside Games, manga artist Michiro Ueyama has announced that he will be producing the final chapter of the Zoids: Chaotic Century manga series next year. The original Zoids: Chaotic Century manga ran from 1999 to 2001 in the pages of Monthy CoroCoro Comic, while Ueyama produced his own fan manga, Zoids EX: Chaotic Century, around the same time via his personal website.
Zoids: Chaotic Century's Original Manga Artist Confirms Return of the Story in 2027
Zoids EX: Chaotic Century was discontinued shortly after it began, and was an unofficially produced title, yet it will serve as the basis for the Zoids: Chaotic Century finale after Ueyama received the official blessing of Takara Tomy, which owns the rights to the Zoids franchise. While details regarding the plot of the upcoming finale remain under wraps, those familiar with Ueyama's work will likely have a good idea of what to expect from the series when it returns in 2027.

Fire Force Season 3 – Cour 2 Trailer Released Fallout star Kyle MacLachlan has shared fresh updates on how far the production has progressed on Season 3, along with a potential release window. The Emmy-nominated actor is known for playing Hank MacLean in the Prime Video series.
In a video shared by CrazyGirlVids on X, MacLachlan shared the filming update while speaking with a fan at a signing for his new memoir. The actor said that the third season is nearing its final stretch, with about a month left to shoot. “We’re still shooting away. We’ve got about a month or so to go,” the 67-year-old said.
He later added, “(and then) probably come out maybe May or June. Fingers crossed that it’s soon.” While the actor did not give a specific year, his comments suggest that filming could wrap around November 2026. That said, it is very likely for the show to premiere in May/June 2027.
Prime Video has yet to announce a release date for the show. Hence, his May or June estimate is not an official timeline from the streamer.
What else do we know about Fallout Season 3 so far?
While official plot details remain under wraps, the upcoming season will continue the story after the events of Season 2.
